status: Portable C++ controller and independent charge-arm sequencing host-tested; STM32 HAL and bench qualification pending
startup_order: Drive U25 PA0 CHG_ARM low before storage or I2C operations; preload low before configuring the output. Missing independent arm HAL must fail startup.
Keep CHG_ENABLE and USB_LEGACY_EN low; preload output latch before configuring outputs.
Write and read back common registers and disabled/100mA mode before authorizing input.
Require P2 low for Type-C current advertisement or explicit USB-stack configured 500mA authorization; VBUS voltage alone is insufficient.
With CE disabled, program and read back the selected input/charge limits, then authorize legacy input if applicable.
Enable CE only after VIN power-good, valid temperature, no TS-open, no safety-timer/OVP/eFuse fault, and successful configuration readback.
Assert CHG_ARM only after CE expander write/readback and all policy/status checks succeed.
runtime_requirements: Poll status and configuration well inside the 160-second watchdog interval; any I2C error requests CE/legacy disable and a latched fault.
Keep legacy override low in Type-C mode so withdrawal of the CC advertisement removes input permission in hardware.
USB reset, detach, deconfiguration or suspend immediately revokes legacy authorization; do not infer authorization from cable presence.
Latch the read-to-clear safety-timer fault in supervisor state; do not repeatedly reset or toggle CE to bypass a timeout.
Temperature suspension is enforced by charger hardware; never disable TS or substitute a fixed resistor for the battery thermistor.
After a fault or watchdog reset, require an explicit recovery policy before charging; firmware restart must not erase fault history silently.
Drop independent CHG_ARM before I2C shutdown; qualify reset-time R79 gate discharge and IWDG shutdown for a stalled CPU. Retained U24 state must not alone enable charging.
limitations: Requires ESP32 transport/storage/USB integration, fault injection and bench validation.
Dead-battery recovery requires a Type-C source advertising 1.5A or 3A; no BC1.2 detector or USB PD negotiation is provided.
SW19 off disables the host/expander; powered-off charging is not implemented.
Battery-side modem current bypasses the charger's discharge-current limit; MakerFocus approximately 1.5A operating limit remains unresolved.
4.17V target and nominal 5..45C thermistor thresholds require tolerance and pack qualification.
